requirement_summary: Multi-Oracle disagreement가 unresolved인 상태에서는 영향받는 Final PASS를 금지해야 한다.
subject: src/main/java/kr/co/oruda/onsure/platform/SemanticAssuranceV2WorkflowService.java (oracleMultiEvaluate), assurance.oracle.multi-evaluate v2 operation; contracts/oracle-disagreement-case.v1.schema.json
observed_source: SemanticAssuranceV2DispatcherBridgeTest (real dispatch through the full RBAC/workflow chain)
coverage_notes: When oracle results disagree (more than one distinct decision among the supplied oracle_results), related_decision and the overall decision are both forced to HOLD, never PASS -- disagreement structurally cannot reach a Final PASS through this operation. When every oracle agrees, the case resolves to that shared decision. Duplicate oracle_id in the same call is rejected outright (DUPLICATE_ORACLE_RESULT), and fewer than two oracle_results is rejected as INPUT_REQUIRED -- a 'multi-oracle' evaluation genuinely requires multiple independent oracles, not one oracle counted twice.
